headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Nov. 3 resolved as Limited war / Limbo: no signed deal or interim truce and no new escalation step before Election Day, with prices scored on the Nov. 2 readings. Tracking now runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 66%, escalated 12%, MOU-style 14% and comprehensive 8%; Netanyahu is pressing for strikes right after the vote while Khamenei has authorized talks.
